description: This file defines the 'Square' class, which implements a unary operation for squaring a number within a calculator application. It extends AbstractOperation and implements UnaryOperation, providing methods to get the operation's name and perform the calculation.

classes.name: Square
classes.description: Represents a square operation that calculates the square of a given float value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'x²'.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Calculates and returns the square of the input argument.
